description: Cross-sector Indian annual reports for FinVerify-IND and the Module 27 case study. Sector spread is deliberate: a benchmark built only on IT-services filings would overstate how well extraction transfers, since banks in particular use a structurally different balance sheet.

documents.notes: Ind AS consolidated statements extracted from the integrated annual report.

Banking balance sheet is structurally unlike the others - schedules rather than a single statement. The hardest extraction case in the corpus, and the reason the set is cross-sector. FY24 also absorbs the erstwhile HDFC Limited amalgamation, so prior-year comparatives are not like-for-like.
Segment reporting across unrelated businesses - tests cross-table questions.
R&D capitalisation and large intangibles; exposes unit and scale variety.
Heavy segment and subsidiary detail (JLR); negative-value line items are common, which exercises sign handling.
